title: STM32F4 Discovery (STM32F407VG, Cortex-M4F) on Renode 1.17.0
platform: Renode 1.17.0's STM32F4 Discovery board (platforms/boards/stm32f4_discovery.repl) and STM32F4 CPU model (platforms/cpus/stm32f4.repl), copied beside the profile without the CPU file's SVD download and register tags; user button on PA0, user LED on PD12

peripherals.name: usart2
peripherals.note: Bytes only: no baud rate, framing or line timing is modeled.

peripherals.name: timer2
peripherals.note: Counts at the model's fixed 10 MHz; the RCC clock tree does not change it.

peripherals.name: gpioPortA
peripherals.note: PA0 is driven by the modeled user button.

peripherals.name: gpioPortD
peripherals.note: PD12 drives the modeled user LED.

unsupported: The clock tree (RCC, PLL, flash wait states) does not change the execution speed or the timer rates of the model.
Instruction timing is not cycle-accurate: the CPU model executes at its configured MIPS.
Peripherals without a model in platforms/cpus/stm32f4.repl (for example the DAC, ADC, USB OTG, SDIO and DCMI) are not simulated.
The audio codec, accelerometer and other parts of the Discovery board outside the STM32F407 are not modeled.

The register tags of the upstream CPU file (GPIOE_MODER, GPIOE_OTYPER, USB:RESET) and its SVD register names are left out: an access to an unmodeled register is reported as an access to a non-existing peripheral.
